findings.summary: Stronger student problem mode retained answer text in speech.
findings.fix: Let canonical snapshot validation collect original blocked text before erasure.

findings.summary: Concurrent note creation could exceed the 1000-note limit.
findings.fix: Recheck capacity inside the serialized write transaction.

findings.summary: Conditional note deletion could report success without removing a row.
findings.fix: Serialize revision validation and verify the deleted row count.

findings.summary: Duplicate student assignments raised an unhandled database error.
findings.fix: Reject duplicates before changing saved assignments.

findings.summary: Malformed student questions returned an unhandled error.
findings.fix: Translate parsing and validation failures into HTTP 422.

findings.summary: Reader-mode results were written into a hidden task.
findings.fix: Keep the single reader live region outside task-hidden sections.

findings.summary: An old deletion completion cleared a newer editor.
findings.fix: Preserve a different active editor and recheck scope after storage removal.

findings.summary: Overlapping local-persistence and network saves used stale revisions.
findings.fix: Cover persistence and request completion with the same save promise.

findings.summary: An obsolete source lookup replaced newer student editing.
findings.fix: Check editor generation before starting the linked note.

findings.summary: Saved-draft cleanup could remove a newer dirty recovery draft.
findings.fix: Restore newer content under the captured original scope after cleanup.

notes: Merged Python, keyboard and live-region specialist findings.
Source review and disposable reproductions; not real screen-reader listening.
